How much is a private speedboat on Koh Samui? | From 19,000 THB per boat for the PP 30 ft (price for up to 4 guests, maximum 8) to 46,000 THB for the MN Speed Boat (price for up to 10, maximum 37). The price depends on the boat, the route and the number of guests, and is confirmed on your written quote.
How many people fit on a speedboat? | Our speedboats take 8 to 37 guests plus crew: PP 30 ft up to 8, Coco Cay up to 10, KT up to 14, NP up to 16, PP 40 ft up to 22, PP 35 ft and FS up to 28, AP up to 30 and MN up to 37. We never load a boat above its maximum.
What is included in the private speedboat charter price? | Captain and crew, fuel, insurance, life jackets in adult and children's sizes, snorkel gear, water and soft drinks, and on most boats fruit and a guide. Hotel transfers are included on the PP 30 ft, NP and PP 40 ft. Lunch and park fees are extra.
Are national park fees included on a private speedboat? | No. Fees are paid in cash on the day: Ang Thong 300 THB per foreign adult and 150 THB per child, Koh Nang Yuan 250 THB per adult, Koh Madsum about 50 THB and Koh Rap about 100 THB.
Can we design our own speedboat route? | Yes. Tell us the islands and beaches you want and how long you want at each, and the captain builds the route, adjusted on the day for tide, wind and sea. Ang Thong is not possible from 1 November to 15 December.
Can the speedboat crew pick us up from our hotel or villa? | Hotel transfer to the pier is included on the PP 30 ft, NP and PP 40 ft, and can be arranged for other boats. Villas on steep hillside roads may need a meeting point at the bottom of the hill.
Is a half-day speedboat charter possible on Samui? | Yes on Coco Cay, which runs 4-hour programmes to Koh Tan and Koh Madsum or to Koh Phangan, and on request for other boats. Most of our speedboat programmes are 8-hour days, which Ang Thong and Koh Tao need.
Can our private speedboat go to Ang Thong in November? | No. The national marine park closes every year from 1 November to 15 December and reopens on 16 December. In November we take speedboat charters to Pig Island, Koh Tan and Koh Rap instead.
Is a speedboat suitable for young children or pregnant guests? | Children are welcome and must wear the life jackets we provide. Speedboats bump hard in a chop, so for pregnant guests or anyone with back problems we recommend a catamaran or a short, sheltered route on a calm day, and a seat at the back of the boat.
How do we pay for a private speedboat and when is it confirmed? | After you accept our written quote, you pay through a secure card payment link, charged in THB. The booking is confirmed once payment is received, by email or WhatsApp, with the pier location and meeting time.
